fusions.name: Bounding Haymaker
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target and land with your full weight, which deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Skip and Stomp
fusions.desc: Hops and stamps down, which deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring-Loaded Thighs
fusions.desc: One push of your legs carries you 8 tiles forward, and your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Weight on Landing
fusions.desc: When you have covered a stretch of ground, your next ability deals 40% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
